Supporting lemmas are grouped with their mathematical result; separate result families and selected boundary results have explicit abstract phrases. families.account: The native prefix driver halts with the declared enumeration output under source-matching promises.
The returned list is duplicate-free, canonically ordered and exactly the detecting eligible sets.
Each enumerated set yields the canonical physical detection realization.
The next iterator and stream step have the displayed bounded delay and continuation or halt behavior.
Program word count and whole output-sensitive execution satisfy the stated native bounds.
